ctx.x: musicians with piano, bass saxophone, banjo, washboard, clarinet and trumpet. Marcel Bornstein, who plays a very good trumpet, had played with Reveliott's band, and Sidney Bechet. We recorded 10 original compositions of Fonsèque and myself, and we were very pleased with the album which was different from other things that I have recorded. We nammed the album "Bill and the Boys" B.C. with Raymond Fonsèque and his Original Jazz Band.

In June, I participated in another French Festival located in Normandy, in a village called Luneray. This festival was taking place in a potato storage barn, and there was an attendance of 10,000 people in those days. Plenty of amateur bands were there, and 4 or 5 professional ones. Also, 2 or 3 wellknown artists as attraction. The music was non-stop from 10 in the morning until 9 in the evening. People could eat and drink there at a very moderate price. The 21st of June, I did a concert in Joinville, a suburb of Paris with Benny Carter, Ben Webster, Kenny Drew, Art Taylor, Michel Sarbadi, Johnny Griffin, The Golden Gate Quartet. I could only make one concert because I had to leave the next day for Morocco, but there were going to be three concerts in the same theatre, the 21st, 22nd, and 23rd.
